governance_note: Strictly feasibility analysis only. Zero production models trained and zero trading thresholds optimized. Uses conservative day-level cluster dependence (not naive i.i.d. VIF=1.0).

macro_15m_assessment.regime_coverage_limitation: Only 85 active dates (~68 clean weekdays, ~3 months Aug-Nov 2026) in a single macro gold environment ($3,500-$4,500). Day-clustered N_eff (1554.2) is much smaller than raw non-overlapping windows (6321) due to within-day regime/volatility clustering.

regularized_logistic_regression.role: Primary baseline for G3.3; low variance, naturally calibrated via Platt/temperature scaling.

constrained_lightgbm.constraints_required: max_depth<=3, num_leaves<=7, min_child_samples>=150, strong L2 reg, feature_fraction<=0.7, strict purged walk-forward CV. High risk of overfitting to Aug-Nov macro regime without additional historical months.

macro_15m_assessment.calibration_requirement: Use Platt / temperature scaling (not isotonic regression, which overfits on day-clustered validation folds).

micro_30_tick_assessment.economic_viability_warning: Median 30-tick |mid_move| is $0.310 vs total round-trip spread+commission friction $0.115 (ratio 2.7x). Standalone 30-tick directional scalping is heavily friction-constrained without L2 order book; Micro ML is better suited as an execution-timing / adverse-selection filter for Macro entries than a standalone 30-tick trading strategy.

regularized_logistic_regression.role: Primary baseline for quote-revision & micro-momentum predictability.

constrained_lightgbm.constraints_required: Shallow trees (max_depth<=4, min_child_samples>=500), labels defined net of spread+commission or used as execution-timing filter, evaluated across unseen calendar weeks with day-block confidence intervals.
